column1: # A SECOND MEMORIAL BOOK THIS ARCHIVE DID NOT KNOW IT WAS STANDING ON.
# Jacob's deportation record is sourced not to the Bundesarchiv but to:
#   "Gedenkbuch Berlins der jüdischen Opfer des Nationalsozialismus", Freie Universität Berlin,
#   Zentralinstitut für sozialwissenschaftliche Forschung, Edition Hentrich, Berlin 1995.
# THAT IS A DIFFERENT BOOK FROM THE ONE CITED ON EVERY PAGE OF THIS SITE. The Bundesarchiv Gedenkbuch
# is national; this is Berlin's own, compiled by the Free University, and it is where the transport
# number comes from. It should be consulted directly for Auguste, for Siegfried, and for the address.
# THE OTHER BERLIN LEIBHOLZES, AND THEY ARE NOT OURS UNTIL SOMETHING SAYS THEY ARE.
# The same search returns a substantial Berlin family this archive has never accounted for:
#   WILHELM 1890 · ELSE 1889 · RUTH 1923 · LIESELOTTE 1923 · WALTER 1922 · CHANA 1938 ·
#   HEINRICH 1890 · ALBERT 1886 · MAX 1877 · HANS ISRAEL 1912 (born Preussisch Friedland)
# Most are on the List of Deportation from Berlin. WHETHER ANY OF THEM IS A COUSIN IS UNKNOWN AND IS
# NOT GUESSED HERE. What is worth saying is that Sally Leibholz and Friederike Schmul had more than
# the three or four sons this archive has names for, and a Berlin Leibholz of the right age is the
# obvious place a fifth would appear.
# *** A DECOY TO WRITE DOWN BEFORE IT COSTS SOMEBODY A DAY ***
#   "KURT LEIBHOLZ, 1927, BERLIN, MURDERED" — List of deportation from Berlin.
# THAT IS NOT OUR KURT. Ours is KURT LUWINSKI, born 11 May 1912, who left Germany in 1933 and died
# in Johannesburg in 1968. A Kurt Leibholz of the same city, fifteen years younger, murdered, is
# exactly the kind of near-match this archive has been caught by three times in a fortnight.
# *** THE PAGES OF TESTIMONY, AND TWO RELATIVES WHO SURVIVED TO WRITE THEM ***
# A Page of Testimony is a form filled in BY A PERSON who knew the dead. It names the submitter and
# their relationship. Eighteen exist under this surname. Two were opened.
# ELLI STRUZIK née LEIBHOLZ — Yad Vashem 13689593, Page of Testimony item 1819733
#   Date of birth        07/11/1915, Berlin        (the register here has "Nov 7 1915" — exact match)
#   FATHER'S FIRST NAME  GEORG
#   MOTHER'S FIRST NAME  LYDIA / LIDIA
#   MOTHER'S MAIDEN NAME PERL
#   Married, spouse      HARRY / HARI
#   Profession           Secretary        Age at death 26
#   Deported             BERLIN to LITZMANNSTADT (Łódź) GHETTO, 01/11/1941
#                        LITZMANNSTADT to CHEŁMNO EXTERMINATION CAMP, 13/05/1942
#   *** SUBMITTER: MARGOT COX — RELATIONSHIP TO VICTIM: COUSIN ***
# GEORG LAIBHOLZ / LEIBHOLTZ — Page of Testimony item 1684365
#   Date of birth        1883            (a THIRD year: Gedenkbuch 1884, Arolsen 1885, this 1883)
#   Born                 Germany
#   Married, spouse      LIDIA, maiden name PERETZ
#   Residence            Berlin
#   PROFESSION           FACTORY OWNER
#   Place of death       Auschwitz       (the deportation lists say Chełmno via Łódź — see below)
#   *** SUBMITTER: IRMGARD SHTERN — RELATIONSHIP TO VICTIM: NIECE ***
# WHAT THESE TWO NAMES ARE, AND WHAT THEY ARE NOT.
# THEY ARE NOT KURT'S RELATIVES ON ANY EVIDENCE THIS ARCHIVE HOLDS. This site's position, argued at
# length on the Leibholz page, is that GEORG IS NOT JACOB'S BROTHER: Jacob was born at Schubin in
# Posen on 8 August 1884 and Georg at Hammerstein in West Prussia two months earlier, and two men
# cannot be brothers on those dates. Margot Cox and Irmgard Shtern are relatives OF GEORG'S LINE.
# WHICH IS EXACTLY WHY THEY MATTER. IRMGARD SHTERN IS GEORG'S NIECE, so her parent was GEORG'S
# SIBLING — and Georg's parents are the one thing that would settle whether his line touches Sally
# Leibholz and Friederike Schmul of Schubin at all. A niece is one generation from the answer.
# MARGOT COX IS ELLI'S COUSIN, so her parent was a sibling of Georg or of Lydia Perl.
# Both are published by Yad Vashem as part of a public memorial record; naming the submitter is the
# whole purpose of a Page of Testimony. Both would now be past a hundred.
# THREE DISCREPANCIES CARRIED RATHER THAN RESOLVED:
#   GEORG'S BIRTH YEAR is 1884 (Bundesarchiv, Yad Vashem list), 1885 (Arolsen), 1883 (this Page).
#   LYDIA'S MAIDEN NAME is PERL on Elli's Page and PERETZ on Georg's.
#   GEORG'S PLACE OF DEATH is AUSCHWITZ on this Page and CHEŁMNO, via the Łódź ghetto, on the
#     deportation lists. A Page of Testimony is written from memory, years later, by a relative who
#     was not there. THE DEPORTATION LIST IS THE BETTER SOURCE and this archive keeps Chełmno.
# AND ONE THING IS NOW CONFIRMED THAT WAS AN ASSERTION: this site has said that Georg's wife was
# LYDIA née PERL and that she died on the same day he did. HER MAIDEN NAME IS ON HER DAUGHTER'S
# PAGE OF TESTIMONY, written by a cousin. And Elli's own death is no longer "after 13 May 1942" —
# IT IS 13 MAY 1942, AT CHEŁMNO, on the transport out of the Łódź ghetto.
# *** THE GREAT-GRANDPARENTS, DOCUMENTED AT LAST — FROM AN AUSCHWITZ DEATH REGISTER ***
# SAMUEL ISRAEL LEIBHOLZ — Yad Vashem 5415605
#   Date of birth        28/06/1877
#   Place of birth       Schubin, Szubin, Poznan, Poland
#   FATHER'S FIRST NAME  SALI
#   MOTHER'S FIRST NAME  FRIDERICKE
#   MOTHER'S MAIDEN NAME SCHMUL
#   Married, spouse      FRIEDA                        <- NEW. This archive had no wife for Samuel.
#   During the war       Berlin
#   PLACE OF DEATH       Auschwitz — DATE OF DEATH 10/04/1943
#   Content note         DOCUMENT NUMBER 18258/1943
#   Source               AUSCHWITZ DEATH REGISTERS, The State Museum Auschwitz-Birkenau
# THE CHART ON THE FRONT PAGE OF THIS SITE HAS SAID "SALLY LEIBHOLZ & FRIEDERIKE SCHMUL" SINCE THE
# FIRST DAY, ON THE FAMILY TREE'S WORD. HERE ARE BOTH OF THEM, NAMED ON A GERMAN DEATH REGISTER KEPT
# AT AUSCHWITZ, AGAINST A NUMBERED ENTRY, FOR A MAN BORN AT SCHUBIN IN 1877.
# It is the first primary source this archive has ever had for the great-grandparents. The spelling
# is SALI and FRIDERICKE, which is what the clerk wrote.
# AND A TEST WAS BUILT OUT OF IT AND RUN. Yad Vashem can be searched on MOTHER'S MAIDEN NAME.
# Searching SCHMUL returns people from Berlin to Łódź to Komarów — it is a common name — and
# EXACTLY ONE LEIBHOLZ: Samuel. So no brother of Jacob and Samuel is recorded anywhere in this
# database with those parents. That is a limit of the records rather than of the family: Jacob's and
# Oskar's entries come from DEPORTATION LISTS, which carry no parents' fields at all. ONLY A PAGE OF
# TESTIMONY OR A DEATH REGISTER CARRIES PARENTS, and of the four brothers only Samuel has one.
# ——— ADDED 20 SEPTEMBER 2026: THE BERLIN DIRECTORY AND THE NAMES DATABASE, SIDE BY SIDE ———
# The whole surname in the Shoah Names Database: 99 results, 88 about victims, from seven sources —
# List of Murdered Jews from Germany 47 · List of Deportation from Berlin 41 · PAGE OF TESTIMONY 18 ·
# Theresienstadt inmates 8 · List of Persecuted Persons 5 · Lodz ghetto inmates 3 · Jews Murdered in Auschwitz 2.
# THE POINT: the 1940 Berliner Adressbuch yields ELEVEN LEIBHOLZ HOUSEHOLDERS (see
# data/berlin-adressbuch-names.tsv). At least four of them are in this database. A city directory and
# a register of the murdered, describing the same handful of people.
# THE RULE APPLIED THROUGHOUT: a name in two lists is a CORRESPONDENCE until an address or a date of
# birth joins them. Berlin held four million people. This archive has twice published a person built
# out of two — the two Emma Hawkinses, and a John Anderson Wear who turned out to be a Texan.
Samuel Israel Leibholz
column2: List of Jews Murdered in Auschwitz
column5: IDENTIFIED, AND THE ONLY ONE OF THE FOUR THAT IS. The Berliner Adressbuch gives the wholesale hatter at KOMMANDANTENSTRASSE 29 and the Gedenkbuch gives Samuel Leibholz of KOMMANDANTENSTR. 29, KREUZBERG. Same street, same number. In the 1940 volume his forename has gone and the entry reads simply "Israel, Hüte" — the 1938 decree operating in a telephone book.

column1: Wilhelm Leibholz
column2: List of Deportation from Berlin; List of Theresienstadt Camp Inmates; List of Murdered Jews from Germany
column5: CORRESPONDENCE BY NAME AND CITY ONLY. The 1940 directory holds TWO Wilhelm Leibholz householders — a Fleischermeister at Neukölln, Lenaustraße 25, and a Vertreter at NO18 Weinstraße 6. Nothing here says which, or whether either.

column1: Albert Leibholz
column5: CORRESPONDENCE ONLY. The 1938 directory has Albert Leibholz, ANTIQUITÄTEN, Halensee, Westfälische Straße 66. Yad Vashem's fate wording for him is unusual — "perished during the period 1933-1945 in indirect relation with the Shoah" — and is quoted rather than paraphrased.

column1: Heinrich Leibholz
column5: CORRESPONDENCE ONLY. The 1940 directory has Heinrich Leibholz, Verwaltungsbeamter, Neukölln, Leinestraße 32. Fate not stated by Yad Vashem.

column1: THE PROFESSIONS FACET
column2: Yad Vashem facet counts for the surname
column5: SHOP OWNER 2 · BUTCHER 1 · FACTORY OWNER 1 · HOUSEWIFE 1 · MERCHANT 1 · PAINTER 1 · SECRETARY 1. THE DIRECTORY HAS TWO LEIBHOLZ FLEISCHERMEISTER — master butchers — one of them listed in 1940 as "A. Israel". Two independent sources describing the same small group of Berlin tradespeople.

column1: Hans Israel Leibholz
column2: List of Jews Murdered in Auschwitz
column5: A NEW LEAD ON THE GEORG QUESTION. This archive's position is that GEORG IS NOT JACOB'S BROTHER, because Georg was born at HAMMERSTEIN, KREIS SCHLOCHAU, WEST PRUSSIA while Jacob, Samuel and Oskar were born at Schubin in Posen. PREUSSISCH FRIEDLAND IS IN KREIS SCHLOCHAU — Georg's own district. A Leibholz born there in 1912 is the right age to be Georg's son, and Irmgard Shtern already calls herself Georg's niece. THIS DOES NOT MAKE GEORG A BROTHER. IT MAKES HIM A FAMILY — a second, West Prussian Leibholz line, and Hans is the first member of it found besides Georg and Lydia.

column1: # ——— ADDED 20 SEPTEMBER 2026: THE LENAUSTRASSE HOUSEHOLD, RECONSTRUCTED ACROSS FOUR SOURCES ———
# 18 Pages of Testimony exist under this surname. Two were read on 17 September. Two more were read
# today, chosen because the Berlin directory work had already identified the household they describe.
# THIS FAMILY IS NOT SHOWN TO BE RELATED TO JACOB, SAMUEL OR OSKAR. It is the same uncommon surname in
# the same city, and it is here because four independent records describe one man and they agree.
WILLI [WILLY] LEIBHOLZ
column5: He was a BUTCHER. Prior to WWII he lived in Berlin. Married, spouse's first name ERNA. PLACE OF DEATH: AUSCHWITZ, POLAND, 1943. Age given as 45.

column1: and what that closes
column5: THE BERLINER ADRESSBUCH GIVES "Wilhelm, FLEISCHERMEISTER, Neukölln, LENAUSTRASSE 25" in 1940, 1941 and 1942, AND NOTHING IN 1943. Yad Vashem gives the same man's trade, the same city, his wife's name and the place he died. The directory's silence in 1943 is explained by Auschwitz in 1943 — WHICH IS NOT SOMETHING THE DIRECTORY COULD EVER HAVE SAID, and is why the Heinrich control matters: absence from these books means nothing on its own.

column1: ERNA LEIBHOLZ
column5: Married, spouse's first name WILLY. PLACE OF DEATH: AUSCHWITZ. Mapping the Lives gives her as ERNA née HAMMER, born 20.01.1897, of Lenaustr. 25 Erdgeschoss, died before 08.05.1945.

column1: *** AND THE SAME PERSON WROTE BOTH FORMS ***
column5: SUBMITTER: EVA KHAVA [P.] HAMMER OLSHER. RELATIONSHIP TO VICTIM: NIECE, on both. She is a HAMMER — Erna's own family — so the survivor who recorded this household came through the wife's side, not the husband's. A THIRD PAGE OF TESTIMONY EXISTS for HEINZ LEIBHOLZ, born 1922, who is the Heinz Paul Hugo of Lenaustraße 25; it has not been opened.

column1: AND THERE ARE PHOTOGRAPHS
column5: Willi Leibholz's record lists FOUR documents: two Pages of Testimony and TWO ITEMS OF TYPE "PHOTOS". There is a photograph of him in the Yad Vashem collection. This archive reached him from a line of Fraktur in a 1940 address book that it very nearly missed, because only the first entry of a run spells the surname.

column1: ONE INCONSISTENCY, RECORDED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED
column5: the Page of Testimony gives Willi's age as 45 and his birth year as 1893, and his death at Auschwitz in 1943 — which would make him 50. Pages of Testimony are written from memory, sometimes decades later, and their age fields are the weakest thing on the form. THE ARCHIVE IS NOT CHOOSING BETWEEN THEM.

column1: THE BOUND ON THE WHOLE BLOCK
column5: FOUR SOURCES DESCRIBE ONE MAN AND THEY AGREE: a Berlin directory (trade, street, house number), the 1939 census database (dates of birth and death, wife, son), Yad Vashem's name records, and a Page of Testimony written by a surviving niece. NONE OF THEM CONNECTS HIM TO KURT'S FAMILY. Jacob, Samuel and Oskar were born at Schubin in Posen; nothing here says where Willi was born beyond "Germany". Fourteen of the eighteen Pages of Testimony remain unopened.

column1: # *** ADDED 20 SEPTEMBER 2026 — THE DATABASE SEARCHED BY *SUBMITTER*, WHICH IS A DIFFERENT SEARCH ***
# A Page of Testimony names the person who filled it in. So does a Relico questionnaire. Searching
# the SUBMITTER field asks a different question from searching the victim field: not "who died" but
# "WHO SURVIVED TO WRITE IT DOWN". Two searches were run. One found a survivor. The other destroyed
# the premise of the work-list row that asked for it, which is the more useful of the two results.
SOPHIE LEIBHOLZ — *** A SURVIVOR, AND SHE WAS IN SHANGHAI ***
column5: Searching SUBMITTER LAST NAME = LEIBHOLZ returns three records and all three were filed by one woman: SOPHIE LEIBHOLZ. The source collection is "QUESTIONNAIRES USED FOR THE SEARCH FOR RELATIVES BY RELICO, THE WORLD JEWISH CONGRESS RELIEF COMMITTEE IN GENEVA, COMPLETED BY SURVIVORS IN SHANGHAI, 1946". She got out to Shanghai, and in 1946 she sat down and filled in forms for three people. THIS IS THE FIRST LEIBHOLZ SURVIVOR THIS ARCHIVE HAS A NAME FOR.

column1: who she was looking for (1)
column5: SALLY BINDER, her BROTHER — married, wife Mathilde, a TAILOR, of Berlin-Neukölln, MOTZSTRASSE 13. Status on her form: "person being sought after as missing", with her own note "probably was in Lobositz or in Theresienstadt during the war". THE OTHER RECORDS ANSWER HER: he was deported from Berlin to Auschwitz on 1 MARCH 1943 and murdered.

column1: who she was looking for (2)
column5: MATHILDE BINDER, of Berlin-Neukölln — Sally's wife.

column1: who she was looking for (3)
column5: HEINRICH LEIBHOLZ, her BROTHER-IN-LAW — married, wife AGNES, profession TAX AGENT, address HORNSTRASSE 19, Berlin. *** THIS IS THE CONTROL CASE, AND HE NOW HAS A LIFE ***. This archive used Heinrich to prove that vanishing from the Berlin directory after 1942 does not mean death, because he died in 1948. He now has a birth date, a wife, a street and a trade. AND SOMEBODY WAS LOOKING FOR HIM FROM SHANGHAI IN 1946, WHICH MEANS SHE DID NOT KNOW HE HAD SURVIVED.

column1: what "sister-in-law" tells us
column5: Sophie is Sally Binder's SISTER and Heinrich Leibholz's SISTER-IN-LAW. Read together that makes her SOPHIE née BINDER, married to a brother of Heinrich. HER HUSBAND'S FORENAME IS NOT ON ANY OF THE THREE FORMS and this archive is not guessing it.

column1: *** AND A SECOND SOPHIE LEIBHOLZ, WHO IS NOT THAT ONE ***
column5: SOPHIE LEIBHOLZ née ROTHENBERG, of Berlin, deported BERLIN to AUSCHWITZ on 1 MARCH 1943 and murdered — THE SAME TRANSPORT AS SALLY BINDER. She cannot be the woman who filled in forms in Shanghai in 1946. TWO WOMEN OF THE SAME NAME, and they are kept apart here deliberately.

column1: and where she was born matters
column5: SCHLOCHAU IS THE DISTRICT THAT CONTAINS HAMMERSTEIN — and Hammerstein is where SALLY LEIBHOLZ, Jacob's father and Kurt's grandfather, was born on 7 July 1847. The West Prussian cluster now has four members: Georg (b. Hammerstein 1884), Hans Israel (b. Preussisch Friedland 1912), Sophie née Rothenberg who married into it (b. Schlochau 1887) — and OUR OWN SALLY. This is not a coincidence to be filed away; it is the reason correction 5 says Georg is probably a cousin or a nephew rather than a stranger.

column1: # *** IRMGARD SHTERN FILED SEVENTEEN PAGES OF TESTIMONY. AND SHE IS NOT A LEIBHOLZ. ***
# The work-list row that sent this archive here argued: Irmgard Shtern called herself GEORG'S NIECE,
# so her parent was Georg's sibling, so her other Pages would give GEORG'S PARENTS — which is the one
# fact that would settle whether Georg's line touches Sally Leibholz and Friederike Schmul at all.
# IT WAS A GOOD ARGUMENT AND ITS PREMISE IS WRONG.
the seventeen, by family
column5: SHTRUZIK (Harry 1912, Elli 1915, GIDEON 1940) · LEWINZON (Helmut 1903, Klara 1906) · MENDELZON / MENDELSOHN (Max 1890, Ema 1892, Mia 1928, Louis 1926) · LAIBHOLZ (Georg 1883, Lidia 1884) · PERL (Edit, 21/09/1925) · ORBACH (Tony Toni 1888) · and one "Orzula, surname unknown, 1915". Every one of them of Berlin, and every one murdered.

column1: *** THE THREE PAGES THAT SETTLE IT ***
column5: LIDIA LAIBHOLZ b.1884 — FATHER "ELIUS", MOTHER "MINA". KLARA LEWINZON b.1906 — FATHER "YULIUS", MOTHER "MINA". EMA MENDELZON b.1892 — FATHER "YULIUS", MOTHER "MEINE". Elius and Yulius are one name through the Hebrew, and so are Mina and Meine. THREE SISTERS, DAUGHTERS OF JULIUS AND MINA — and Irmgard Shtern is recorded as NIECE to all three.

column1: *** SO GEORG IS THE UNCLE BY MARRIAGE ***
column5: IRMGARD'S BLOOD IS LIDIA'S FAMILY, NOT THE LEIBHOLZES'. She called Georg her uncle because he married her aunt. HER PAGES CANNOT GIVE GEORG'S PARENTS AND NEVER COULD. The row's whole argument is withdrawn, and the open question — whether Georg's line touches Sally Leibholz and Friederike Schmul — is exactly where it was.

column1: and it does give Lydia's parents, which nobody had
column5: LYDIA LEIBHOLZ née PERL (spelt PERETZ on Georg's own Page) WAS A DAUGHTER OF JULIUS AND MINA, and she had at least two sisters, Klara and Ema. The Edit Perl of 1925 on the same list is presumably of that family. A wife who was a name and a maiden name now has parents and siblings.

column1: *** AND A CHILD THIS ARCHIVE DID NOT HAVE ***
column5: GIDEON SHTRUZIK, BORN 1940, marital status "CHILD", of Berlin, MURDERED. FATHER: HARRY (Hari). Harry Struzik was Elli Leibholz's husband, so Gideon is almost certainly ELLI'S SON AND GEORG'S GRANDSON — but HIS MOTHER IS NOT NAMED ON THE PAGE and that last step is an inference, not a record. Elli was deported to the Łódź ghetto on 1 November 1941, when he would have been about one.

column1: Georg's own Page, checked for parents
column5: NO FATHER AND NO MOTHER ON IT. The place of birth is the single word Germany. The Page gives a wife, a trade and a death and nothing above him.
